name: FFS_LOCATION
description: Contains predefined locations to be assigned as start/final/home ones to resources.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Label of where resource is located.

columns.name: POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: Postal code where resource is located.

columns.name: COORD_STATUS
columns.description: Status of resource street address resolution - coordinates are found.

columns.name: COORD_ACCURACY
columns.description: Status of resource street address resolution accuracy Level Of Geocoding Coordinates Not Valid - -1 Undefined - 0 Country - 1 State - 2 County - 3 City - 4 Zip - 5 Route - 6 Street - 7 Intersection - 8 Address - 9.

columns.name: TRAVEL_KEY
columns.description: Resource location travel key. Calculated automatically based on configured oTravel Key on Business Rules screen.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: COORD_VIEWPORT_RADIUS
columns.description: Radius of resource location viewport returned by geoprovider in meters.

columns.name: PERSONAL_ADDRESS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this is the personal address of the contact.
